description: This file defines the 'MyContactsDashlet' class, which extends 'DashletGeneric' to implement a custom dashboard widget (dashlet) for displaying contacts in SuiteCRM. It includes constructor logic to load dashlet data, set title, and initialize display columns and search fields.

classes.name: MyContactsDashlet
classes.description: A dashlet class that provides a customizable contact list widget in SuiteCRM's dashboard.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the dashlet with data, title, search fields, columns, and seed bean.
